meta.name: threejs-performance
meta.description: Three.js 性能优化指南。当 Three.js/React Three Fiber 项目出现掉帧、内存增长、加载缓慢、绘制调用过多，或需要迁移 WebGPU、实现大规模粒子/实例化渲染、配置资源压缩管线时使用。触发关键词："Three.js 优化"、"WebGPU"、"draw calls"、"内存泄漏"、"TSL"、"InstancedMesh"、"R3F 优化"等。不用于：通用 React 性能问题（用 vercel-react-best-practices）、WebGL/Three.js 入门教学、3D 美术资产的制作本身。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 优化 Three.js 场景性能，解决掉帧和内存问题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果 Three.js 项目出现性能瓶颈，需要专业优化方案
copy.tagline_en: Optimize Three.js scene performance, fix frame drops and memory issues
copy.fit_line_en: For you if your Three.js project hits performance bottlenecks and needs professional optimization

howto.what: Claude 会分析 Three.js 或 React Three Fiber 项目的性能问题，提供优化建议，如减少绘制调用、管理内存、压缩资源、迁移 WebGPU 等。
howto.when: 当用户提到“Three.js 优化”、“WebGPU”、“draw calls”、“内存泄漏”、“InstancedMesh”等关键词，或描述掉帧、内存增长、加载慢等问题时触发。

say.text: 我的 Three.js 场景掉帧，绘制调用太多，怎么办？
say.note: Claude 会检查绘制调用数并建议实例化或合批。

say.text: 如何用 WebGPU 提升粒子性能？
say.note: Claude 会指导迁移 WebGPU 并使用计算着色器。

say.text: R3F 项目内存一直增长，怎么清理？
say.note: Claude 会提供 dispose 铁律和对象池方案。

howto.what_en: Claude analyzes performance issues in Three.js or React Three Fiber projects, providing optimization advice such as reducing draw calls, managing memory, compressing assets, and migrating to WebGPU.
howto.when_en: Triggered when users mention keywords like "Three.js optimization", "WebGPU", "draw calls", "memory leak", "InstancedMesh", or describe issues like frame drops, memory growth, or slow loading.

say_en.text: My Three.js scene is lagging with too many draw calls. What should I do?
say_en.note: Claude will check draw call count and suggest instancing or batching.

say_en.text: How can I use WebGPU to improve particle performance?
say_en.note: Claude will guide migration to WebGPU and use of compute shaders.

say_en.text: Memory keeps growing in my R3F project. How to clean up?
say_en.note: Claude will provide the dispose rule and object pool approach.
